last_run.draft_in_english:
Hi! Open the shift in the app and tap “Offer swap.” Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken. Good to know: manager approval is on by default, but you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster.

Hope this helps!
